source: Animation ids and engine states that ordinary monsters (object ids 0x00-0x1F) use beyond what their AI script requests. Read from $C0:3A79 (combat tick), $C0:4EBC/4F1E/4F4F/4E6B (reaction chooser), $C0:3E80/3F08 + $C1:2698 + D0:4ED3 (status vector), $C8:E301/E52F/E5FF (status apply and appearance), $C1:D94F (command executor), $C1:E40E + D1:05C0 (swing chooser), $C0:F550-F585 (animation table lookup), $C0:F90B-F9B0 (animation-script hold ops FC/FE); executed with tools/rip_monster_anims.py's Rip harness, tools/ai_sim.py, tools/summon_sim.py. Numbers only. Frames are 60.0988 Hz video frames.

animation_lookup.rule: state 0: ordinary table, id; state != 0 and id < 0x80: attack table, id; state != 0 and id >= 0x80: ordinary table, id & 0x7F
animation_lookup.restart: the script restarts when the word +0x10/+0x11 changes (or +0x30 = 0xFF is forced); at the end of an animation script in state 0 it loops, in state 0x40/0x80 the state and +0x11 go back to 0

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: a new status bit in 0x4560 (0x0020, 0x0040, 0x0100, 0x0400, 0x4000) is applied: E1FB bit1 is set by $C8:E301, the combat tick returns code 2/param 0 (one ordinary animation 0 pose, velocities zeroed, +0x30=FF)
pending HP damage <= max HP/4 ($C0:4EBC), or pending MP damage with $E187/4 >= damage ($C0:4F1E); suppressed while status & 0xC578
reaction_codes_monsters.hold: script op FC holds the last picture until the damage-number overlay (+0x60 = 0x40, frames 5-102) ends, then FE, then the rest of the script

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: pending HP damage > max HP/4, or MP damage above $E187/4; also written (+1) for a lethal hit before the corpse object takes over
reaction_codes_monsters.motion: knock-back opposite to the facing, 0..45 px, per monster (reaction_measured.big.end_disp)

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: sleep status 0x0010 applied (E1B1 bit0 set by $C8:E4B5, consumed by the tick: $C0:3BCC)
reaction_codes_monsters.hold: script ops FC + FE hold the last picture while status & 0x7B; the pose ends after the status

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: the hit test failed ($C0:4FE0) or the damage after defense was 0 ($C0:5176): $C0:4E6B picks 0x0C + (rnd*3)>>8; skipped while E175 != 0 or status & 0xC57D
reaction_codes_monsters.frames: 25 for ids 0-31 in most cases, see rip_summary hurt12-14
reaction_codes_monsters.motion: ordinary 13 and 14 hop 15-16 px (jump 15) in the rip; 12 is in place

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: pending HP heal ($E1F3) or MP heal ($E1F6) applied ($C0:4F4F)
reaction_codes_monsters.hold: FC holds while the damage-number overlay runs; AI free at frame 105 (all 32 ids)

reaction_codes_monsters.trigger: hit registered (E175 set): damage-number overlay only (+0x60 = 0x40, +0x84 = 3); no animation change

not_used_for_ordinary_monsters.note: no engine reaction, status or spell writes 6, 7, 11, 15, 16, 17 for ordinary monsters. 11 is asked by the scripts of ids 9 and 18 only. 15, 16, 17 (110-155 frame tumbling poses) and 6, 7 are not requested by any path found (unknown)

status.advances: the pose runs to its hold op and stays on that picture while the status lasts; AI blocked (state 0x40); status removed by a damaging hit

status.visual: the monster becomes object id 0x83 (a different picture set: 4 pieces of 16x16, tiles 64/66/68/70 at (-16,-30), palette row 5 changed); the object-table entry 0x83 has script pc 0x648E
status.advances: no: one picture, script loops E3 00 00 (ordinary 0 turn commands)
status.end: E180 is restored from +0x1E7, graphics reloaded, script restarts at the entry

status.visual: ordinary 0x13 (19) looped, drawn with a changed palette row 5; at the end ordinary 0x14 (20) once, normal palette
status.palette: row 5 changes during 19 (grey) and returns during 20
status.advances: 19 repeats every command (15 frames for id 0, per monster in per_monster.rip.ord19)
status.mechanism: script pc 0x648E called through the status vector
status.tag: V (id 0 real AI); pictures from the rips

status.visual: balloon: 7-9 extra 16x16 pieces in the second piece list (tiles 200-206, 224-232, palette row 4) above the body, shape by spell level $9D (<4: record 0xF2, <8: 0xF3, else 0xF4); body unchanged
status.advances: body: ordinary 0 turn commands (20 frames) while the status lasts, balloon static

status.visual: ordinary monsters are immune (status_immunity bits 0x0200, 0x0400, 0x1000 in every record 0x00-0x1F)
the monster is replaced by one of 8 objects (ids 0,2,4,6,8,0xC,0x16,0x17: table at $C8:E5F3, random); graphics, palette, animations and AI script of that object
status.tag: V (picture and id), C (AI script switch)

status.visual: none; 1 HP lost per timer drop (every 4th tick)
flame: 4 extra 16x16 pieces in the second piece list (tiles 200-206, palette row 4) over the body, flipped horizontally every 10 frames (id 0); body keeps palette row 5
status.advances: the monster turns on the spot: C1 commands dir 8, 1, 4, 2 (up, right, down, left), ordinary 0, 5 frames each; hit reactions are suppressed; 1 HP lost per timer drop

status_vector.rom: $C0:3E80/3F08 -> JSL $C1:0024 (= $C1:2698) with A = 2 for monsters (A = 1 when +0x1FB bit 7 is set) -> script pc from the word table at D0:4ED3
status_vector.behaviour: the current script pc is pushed on the script call stack; the routine tests status & 0x4160 and loops while a bit is set; RET resumes the monster script where it was

loops.ops: E3 13 00 while set, then E3 14 00 once
E3 00 00 while set, then E3 01 0A once

commands.anim: attack table animation = param, state 0x40, E064 = 0x80
attack table animation = param, state 0x40; the monster casts spell id +0x170 (MP check $C1:1E2C)
commands.script_ops: E9 (one target), EA (all targets): args anim, spell id

commands.anim: creates a new object with id = param in a free slot
the object turns into object id param2 (+0x180, +0x3D), graphics and script reloaded
ordinary animation = param2 in state 0, direction code param1, length param3
commands.script_ops: E0, E3, E4, E6, FD, FE, BE, BF

commands.anim: swing, state 0x80, attack animation chosen by $C1:E40E from D1:05C0 + id*0x20 (+0x10 when +0x1E4 bit 7)

command_executor.tag: C (handlers read; E9/ED/EF/E2 ops executed by tools/monster_commands.py of the other agent)
